h1: What are Newton's minimum open space and permeable surface requirements?
title: Newton Open Space and Lot Coverage: Rules by Zoning District
description: Compare Newton's published open-space and lot-coverage standards and learn why the property's district and creation date matter.
short_answer: Newton's required open space and maximum lot coverage vary by zoning district and lot creation date. For single-residence lots created on or after December 7, 1953, the ordinance lists minimum open space of 70% in SR1, 65% in SR2, and 50% in SR3. Older lots have a different table, so a single citywide percentage is not correct.

facts.text: For lots created on or after December 7, 1953, Newton's table lists minimum open space of 70% in SR1, 65% in SR2, and 50% in SR3.
Newton uses a separate dimensional table for lots created before December 7, 1953.
Newton Engineering reviews expansions of impervious area, including patios, pools, and driveways.

qa.q: Can I use the SR2 open-space percentage for every Newton property?
qa.a: No. The applicable percentage depends on the zoning district and the lot's creation date. Other districts have their own standards.
